1.problem: Collaborate on code, track changes, and ship software with a shared source of truth.
1.audience: Developers, open-source maintainers, and engineering teams.
notFor: Teams looking for a no-code-only workspace

pricing.summary: Public repositories are available at no cost; team and enterprise features vary by plan.

privacy.dataCollection: Repository, account, activity, and service telemetry depend on the features and plan used.
privacy.securityNotes: Review repository visibility, organization policies, secrets handling, and third-party app permissions before publishing code.

alternatives.name: GitLab
alternatives.reason: Integrated source control and DevOps workflows

alternatives.name: Bitbucket
alternatives.reason: Git hosting with team workflow integrations

2.problem: Find practical programming answers and learn from a searchable community knowledge base.
2.audience: Developers, students, and technical teams solving implementation problems.
notFor: Private company knowledge that must not be public

pricing.summary: The public Q&A community is free; private organizational knowledge products have separate plans.

privacy.dataCollection: Posts, votes, profiles, and usage data are visible or processed according to the service and account settings.
privacy.securityNotes: Never paste credentials, private customer data, or undisclosed vulnerabilities into a public question.

alternatives.name: MDN Web Docs
alternatives.reason: Primary reference documentation for web technologies

3.problem: Build job-relevant skills through courses, certificates, and online degree programs.
3.audience: Learners, career switchers, students, and teams building professional skills.
notFor: People expecting every course to be fully free
Credentials without completing assessments or program requirements

pricing.summary: Some content can be previewed or accessed free; certificates, subscriptions, and degrees have separate pricing.

privacy.dataCollection: Learning progress, profile, assessment, and enrollment data are processed to provide courses and credentials.
privacy.securityNotes: Check certificate, identity-verification, employer-sharing, and financial-aid terms before enrolling.

4.problem: Organize notes, documents, tasks, and shared knowledge in one flexible workspace.
4.audience: Individuals, creators, students, and teams managing connected information.
notFor: Teams needing a specialized accounting or CRM system
Workflows that require strict offline-first behavior

pricing.summary: A free workspace is available; collaboration, storage, and advanced controls vary by plan.

privacy.dataCollection: Workspace content, account information, integrations, and usage telemetry depend on the features enabled.
privacy.securityNotes: Review guest access, sharing links, integrations, retention, and workspace permissions before storing sensitive material.

alternatives.name: Obsidian
alternatives.reason: Local-first linked notes and knowledge graphs

alternatives.name: Coda
alternatives.reason: Documents with app-like tables and workflows

5.problem: Find on-demand movies and series in a convenient streaming catalog.
5.audience: Viewers and households looking for on-demand entertainment.
notFor: Guaranteed access to one specific title in every country
Users needing a permanently fixed catalog

pricing.summary: Plans, features, and prices vary by country and may change; check Netflix for the current offer.

privacy.dataCollection: Account, device, viewing, interaction, and payment data are used to operate and personalize the service.
privacy.securityNotes: Use account security controls, review household access, and avoid sharing credentials outside the permitted household.

alternatives.name: Prime Video
alternatives.reason: Streaming catalog with rental and purchase options
